name: Solshare
tagline: Scan a shared receipt, assign items to friends and settle instantly on Solana.

awards: Cohere: Best Use of Cohere API
Solana: Best Consumer Payment Experience with Solana Pay

problem: Splitting a big shared receipt fairly is a headache, and bank integrations for instant payment have not arrived.
solution: Receipt scanning with AI, item assignment in an iOS app, and blockchain settlement between friends.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a warehouse-store receipt and settle everyone's share in seconds.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Cohere: Best Use of Cohere API” and “Solana: Best Consumer Payment Experience with Solana Pay” among 261 submissions.
Born from shared grocery runs on one membership.

lessons: A specific student ritual makes a payments demo relatable.
